methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops led by a Norfolk native signal grassroots capability-building outside traditional tech hubs, creating distributed peer learning networks that could enable broad-based fluency beyond elite institutions.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's institutional partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates AI education infrastructure in Richmond's metro core, deepening capability in an existing hub rather than distributing it to underserved regions.

signals.title: Children’s National and Virginia Tech deepen pediatric AI collaboration to accelerate innovation for children - Children's National
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech-Children's National collaboration creates a specialized AI research node leveraging existing university infrastructure, reinforcing the pattern of deep capability clustering around R1 institutions rather than broad distribution.

signals.title: University of Mary Washington Adds Virginia’s First Master’s Degree in AI in Business - Northern Virginia Magazine
signals.signal_reading: UMW's business-focused AI master's degree signals platform-mediated adoption for professional contexts—training people to use AI tools rather than build them, suggesting shallow but potentially scalable diffusion through business networks.

signals.title: Tony Stark’s J.A.R.V.I.S., meet Amelia, Norfolk Naval Shipyard’s IT AI help assistant - MilitaryNews.com
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Naval Shipyard deploying a pre-built IT assistant AI demonstrates shallow adoption through turnkey enterprise solutions in defense-industrial contexts, where workers interface with rather than develop AI systems.
